Hi Jonas,

We're seeing a sustained latency increase (p50 ~2200ms, p95 > 9s) and a surge of 502 responses for inference calls from our US-east customers to the Redwood API since 08:50 PDT. This started abruptly and coincides with some VPC peering changes we made on our side earlier this morning, but the timing also aligns with increased 502s on your /v1/generate endpoints.

Quick summary:
- Impact: 40% of requests returning 502 or timing out for ~30 minutes, then intermittent.
- Scope: Primarily us-east region, several backend pods showing high retransmits.
- Customer impact: Checkout features backed by embeddings failing for a subset of users.

We have attached a short traceroute and a pcap of a failing flow. Can you confirm if there were any peering, firewall or proxy changes on Redwood's edge that could explain asymmetric routing or NAT exhaustion? We're escalating this to our on-call and would appreciate an urgent triage.

Subject: Executive summary and next steps — Cobalt Connect US-east disruption (08:50–10:10 PDT)

Sarah / Cobalt team — thank you for the traceroute and logs; appreciate the fast responses. Quick executive summary from Redwood after initial triage: 

What we saw:
- Between 08:50–10:10 PDT on 2028-08-01 we observed increased 502s and elevated response latency for traffic originating from Cobalt Connect ASN into our US-east edge.
- Edge proxy (envoy) metrics show a sudden rise in active connections and connection resets; kernel-level counters indicate transient conntrack pressure on the NAT table for that egress population.
- No config rollouts to the WAF or proxy cluster were scheduled in that window; however, one peering session to an upstream transit partner experienced intermittent route flaps at 08:48–08:54 PDT which aligned with the customer impact window.

Immediate remediation performed:
- Rerouted affected prefixes to warm pool instances within 12 minutes of detection.
- Increased NAT table size and cleared stale conntrack entries where safe.
- Disabled an overloaded proxy worker group and incrementally scaled ephemeral workers to drain queues.

Proposed short-term actions and asks:
- Redwood: run a detailed conntrack and kernel-level trace; deliver initial findings within 4 hours (by 19:45 PDT).
- Cobalt: confirm any BGP changes or peering maintenance on your side in the same window — your traceroute suggested last-hop queuing.
- Joint: schedule a 30-min incident review with execs and SRE leads today; suggested 17:30 PDT.

Compensation proposal (if we confirm operational contribution on our side): 10% usage credit for the billing month covering the affected traffic, and complimentary one-time premium support credits toward a Dedicated capacity consultation.

Attachments: error-502-screenshot.png (sample failing response)

I'll set up the review and send a short pre-read once Ben and infra have the kernel traces.
